IncidentDef.label: marker impact
IncidentDef.letterText: Something fell from the sky. A blinding flash, a shockwave, and when the dust settled, a black obelisk was standing where the explosion had been. It does not look like anything built by human hands.

IncidentDef.label: infector outbreak
IncidentDef.letterText: The marker's signal has reached the dead. Where the corpses lie together, the ground has split and thin, long-limbed creatures are crawling out. They are looking for bodies to continue.\n\nAn obelisk sculpture standing in the colony would have drowned out the signal.
